note: Well-treed provincial campground on the north bank of the Bighorn River just upstream of Crescent Falls, 22 km west of Nordegg on Hwy 11 and 6 km north on a gravel access road; walk-in tent sites as well as RV sites, and no cell service. The river is fast and cold above and below the falls, and the area below the falls is closed. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Aug 7, 2026), shop and tear sheet: 20 unserviced + 9 walk-in tent sites at C$28, season May 8 - Oct 4 (manual, unchanged), sites 1-19 reservable / 20-31 FCFS, non-potable pump, vault toilets, reservable RV sites 38-73 ft. Shop closed through May 6, 2027. Not waterfront kept (site 002 tagged Near Water under canopy - lead only).
flags: SEASON: page 'Season: May 8 - Oct 4' matches the stored manual season. Shop: 'Closed through Thu May 06 2027' (2027 opening May 7). Advisory 'Day Use Access - Foot Traffic Only' (Oct 8, 2026): 'The campground is closed for the season.' - ordinary seasonal closure, not a status.

PHONE: stored 855-721-3975 = the page's 'Information: 1-855-721-3975' (Facility Operator: Westward Bound Campgrounds; tear sheet 'Westward Bound, Campground Operator Phone: 1-855-721-3975'). Store as 1-855-721-3975.
SENIORS LINE: PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.'). '90 days in advance' matches the provincial:AB row.
FIT: every reservable unserviced site is 38 ft or more on the shop; the four tent-only sites are 14-35 ft. First-come sites 20-31 carry no length on the shop. No fit problem.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront; kept, lead logged): the tear-sheet campground map runs the loop road along the north bank of the Bighorn River with sites 2, 4, 25 and 29 on the river side, and the shop tags site 002 'Near Water' (the only one). Esri imagery (winter, dense conifer canopy with long shadows) does not show the pads or any open ground to the bank; the river is roughly 80-130 m south of the stored pin. The evidence gate cannot be met under canopy, so not waterfront stays.

PIN (52.38712,-116.36491): identical to the page's directions point; under continuous canopy on the north bank, within the campground's western part by the tear sheet's scale. Pads not visible, so no move proposed.
WEBSITE: both stored URLs answered 200 and are this campground.
ROAD: the advisory says the access road and upper parking lot are plowed in winter; no road problem stated for the season.
